verdict.rationale: Canva's first-party docs describe three write-capable surfaces. The official MCP server supports design generation from text, targeted edits to existing designs through natural-language commands, resizing, and asset uploads. The Connect APIs let integrations create and sync designs and assets, and the Apps SDK can add elements to a user's design and automate design tasks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agent-driven create/edit works as documented, and clarity on plan gating (resizing requires Pro or above; private integrations require Enterprise).
